_help: Source of the subscribable calendar (public/calendar.ics and public/calendar-ru.ics). Edit here, then run `npm run calendar` (it also runs on every `npm start`). Times are Cyprus local time. To cancel one Tuesday add its date to weekly[].cancelled; to cancel a one-off run set its "cancelled": true (keep the entry, so subscribers see it disappear). Never change an "id": calendars match events by it.

description.en: Free weekly runs on the Limassol seafront. Updates automatically when the schedule changes.
description.ru: Бесплатные еженедельные пробежки по набережной Лимассола. Обновляется автоматически, если расписание меняется.

title.en: Limassol Seafront Run: first run (3 km)
title.ru: Limassol Seafront Run: первая тренировка (3 км)

location.en: Opposite Dream Tower, blue public sports ground on the seafront, Limassol
location.ru: Напротив Dream Tower, синяя общественная спортплощадка на набережной, Лимассол

notes.en: A shorter 3 km to start. About 45 minutes including warm-up and cool-down. Free, every pace welcome. Bring a friend: they can register at the start via the QR code.
notes.ru: Для начала короче, 3 км. Около 45 минут вместе с разминкой и заминкой. Бесплатно, любой темп. Зовите друга: он зарегистрируется на старте по QR-коду.

notes.en: Weekly run, about 5 km along the water. Free, every pace welcome. If a run is cancelled or moved, this calendar updates and we email everyone on the list.
